_readme: Single source of truth for live numbers. STATE.md is GENERATED from this file by `python3 tools/gates.py --render`. Robinhood always wins: if a live pull disagrees, fix this file first, then run gates.py. Edit positions/orders/calendar here, never in STATE.md.

mandate.rescale_note: On a deposit D to Claude (matched for Codex): contributed += D, scale floor/gate/targets/ratchet/event caps/glide_base by new_contributed/480, update rival.contributed and rival.value (+D), then render.

positions.note: Stop order holds all 3 shares: cancel it before any sell, then re-place on what remains.

positions.note: Target $2,580. Out before 2pm ET Wed 10/28 unless >= +5% ($2,473).

positions.gap_desc: stop converts to a limit 5% under the trigger ($74,955)

price_rules: SOXL >= $112 (T1): cancel stop 6ad61fee, sell 1 share, re-place a stop on the other 2 at $102.55.
SOXL daily CLOSE < $80 (judged at 3:22pm): cancel the stop, sell all.
SOXX daily CLOSE < $495 (gap-and-fail): sell all SOXL.
SOXL not at T1 by Fri 10/23 3:22pm: sell 2 shares. ALL out by Mon 10/26 3:22pm ET regardless.
Day-trade rule: selling a stock bought the same day uses 1 of 3 PDT day trades; spend them only on emergency exits.

calendar.what: OPEN check-in. Re-test SOXL/SOXX vs rules; first run of the new schedule and gates.py.
CLOSE check-in. SOXL close rule (<$80) and SOXX < $495 rule. NFLX reports after the close.
MIDDAY. Pre-screen the METU 10/23 put (four tests, spread <= 40% of mid, OI >= 100, META straddle <= 9.5%).

DECIDE (a) METU 10/23 put, 1 contract, limit <= min(mid, replay cap, $0.50), gate >= $272; (b) hold SOXL through LRCX/META/TSLA/TXN/IBM earnings only if SOXX >= $495 AND floor-distance gate passes with SOXL gapping to $71 (plus put premium).
Exit the put (win or lose). Exit SOXL if the prints broke the thesis. A 4th SOXL share only if SOXL >= +10% over fill, funded by put proceeds/spare cash.
SOXL session-5 rule: sell 2 if T1 ($112) not hit. Re-screen core PCE >0.3 (Rothera ECPCE-26SEPCORE).
SOXL fully out, no matter what.
Re-screen Q3 GDP >3.5 (KXGDP-26OCT30) with latest GDPNow / NY Fed.
FINAL event screen (GDP >3.5, core PCE >0.3). ETH out before 2:00pm FOMC unless >= +5%.
GDP advance + Sept PCE release. Event contracts close 8:29am.

open_items: FRED_API_KEY: not set in the assistant's shell on 10/19; confirm it is available to scheduled runs, then delete this line.
Codex holdings unknown (only its value is reported); ask the user for positions daily.
Pending deposit of $200 still displays in Robinhood but is not in total_value; cash + holdings already reconcile to $480 contributed.
rules: Execution: the assistant does NOT place/cancel/modify orders. It writes the exact order into ORDERS.md (and the thesis into trades.md) and PushNotifications 'ORDER for you: ...'; the user places it in the app.
Thesis block in trades.md BEFORE any order is recommended; post-mortem when a trade closes.
Every holding has a full-quantity stop at Robinhood at all times (gates.py checks coverage).
Options: Level 2 only, four-test screen in STRATEGY.md; CSPs/covered calls banned until equity >= $508.
Crypto: new entries need a written level, target >= 6% away (3x the 1.9% spread) and a stop at the fill. No resting buys that could fill unprotected for > 12h.
Events: Claude picks, the user places by hand. Gates in TRADER_PROMPT v3.1; stake <= $72 total, <= $50 when model-dependent.
Floor: equity < $185 -> stop recommending trades, write postmortem.md. Ratchet: at >= $739 never risk below $640.
Log every probability used in a decision with `python3 tools/track.py cal add ...`; log the benchmark row at every CLOSE check-in.
